When at least one row is added, sort the whole registry numerically, preserving old ID spelling and opaque values, and stamp explicit Updated. Existing update operations retain their order.

When every proposed row is already present, publish/report exact original source bytes/hash and date, preserving true whole-document idempotency. Publication still creates a new exclusive file when apply is requested.
Source, updates table and canonical registry remain read-only. No translation/glyph/markup/fit/reference/patch authorization claim from schema acceptance.
